name: SP1 — Runner script resolves path references in use-case files

steps.text: a use-case file at path tmp/test_usecase.txt with content "This is a real use case description."
read_use_case is called with "@tmp/test_usecase.txt"
the returned text is "This is a real use case description."

scenarios.name: PathResolve-02 read_use_case reads a normal file without @ prefix

steps.text: a use-case file at path tmp/test_usecase.txt with content "This is a real use case description."
read_use_case is called with "tmp/test_usecase.txt"
the returned text is "This is a real use case description."

scenarios.name: PathResolve-03 read_use_case resolves a nested path reference

steps.text: a use-case file at path tmp/outer.txt with content "tmp/inner.txt"
a use-case file at path tmp/inner.txt with content "This is the actual use case content."
read_use_case is called with "tmp/outer.txt"
the returned text is "This is the actual use case content."

scenarios.name: PathResolve-04 read_use_case does not resolve content that looks like prose

steps.text: a use-case file at path tmp/prose.txt with content "This is a long use case description with multiple sentences and newlines.\nIt describes a healthcare AI system.\nThe system uses RAG retrieval."
read_use_case is called with "tmp/prose.txt"
the returned text is the original file content without further resolution

scenarios.name: PathResolve-05 read_use_case raises FileNotFoundError for missing file

steps.text: read_use_case is called with "tmp/nonexistent_usecase.txt"
a FileNotFoundError is raised

scenarios.name: PathResolve-06 read_use_case resolves path references with supported extensions

steps.text: a use-case file at path tmp/outer.<outer_ext> with content "tmp/inner.<inner_ext>"
a use-case file at path tmp/inner.<inner_ext> with content "This is the resolved content."
read_use_case is called with "tmp/outer.<outer_ext>"
the returned text is "This is the resolved content."

scenarios.name: PathResolve-07 read_use_case raises clear error for unresolvable nested path

steps.text: a use-case file at path tmp/outer.txt with content "tmp/missing_ref.txt"
read_use_case is called with "tmp/outer.txt"
a FileNotFoundError is raised
the error message references the unresolved path "tmp/missing_ref.txt"

scenarios.name: PathResolve-08 read_use_case logs the first 100 characters of loaded text

steps.text: a use-case file at path tmp/test_usecase.txt with content "This is a real use case description that is long enough to be meaningful."
read_use_case is called with "tmp/test_usecase.txt"
a log entry is produced containing the first 100 characters of the loaded text
